title: Quarter-scale conditional variance in the binary Hayes identity cylinder
statement: Let ell >= 200, let n be 2 ell + 1 or 2 ell + 2, put c_0=ell-ceil(log2 ell)-2, K=ker(E_ell -> E_c_0), R=#K, x_e=N_ell(e), and S=sum_{e in K}x_e. Then sum_{e in K}(x_e-S/R)^2 <= 2^(2ell-2).

provenance.source: Axeyum gf2-lemire lane; localized positive-square bridge to REL

notes: The native identity_cylinder_quarter_variance_implication operation proves that this statement implies F:gf2-hayes-one-sided-relative-trace, hence the Lemire endpoint, for every ell>=200. identity_cylinder_conditional_variance reconstructs the exact local Haar identity R*V_id=sum_j 2^(j-c0-1) sum_p H_j(p)^2. The weaker conjectured fact F:gf2-hayes-identity-cylinder-polynomial-share plus exact-conductor Parseval and the proved individual-character Weil bound implies this statement. The clean bound is false on some small rows but holds at both endpoint parities for every exact row 14<=ell<=23. Finite evidence is deliberately not attached as universal proof evidence, and no Autogenesis operation is registered because no uniform checker establishes the statement.
